# algosec_security_zones (Data Source)

Security-zone definitions from a risk-profile spreadsheet. Accepts the documented array and status/data response forms.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algosec_security_zones" "example" {
  profile_file = "example.xlsx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile_file` (String) Profile file.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Lookup identity.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Complete returned inventory, deterministically ordered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `addresses` (Set of String) Addresses.
- `name` (String) Name.
